Cozy Farm

A strong support Tatari helps every future fertilizer dose. Arrange support before spending, then grow toward the next reward.

Grow first, collect milestones

The newer Farm V2 event lasts six 12-hour rounds. Crop weight accumulates through the event. Fertilizing, watering, natural growth, and support Tatari all contribute to heavier yields.

This guide covers Farm V2. Older feeding-and-harvesting rules are a different version. Its rewards and formulas should not be mixed with these milestones.

Six crops, specific support Tatari

The default crop pool has six crops. Each requires its own support Tatari family; an unrelated Tatari cannot replace it. Support from your own camp or another trainer is assigned to that crop’s plot, not every crop on the farm.

CropRequired support Tatari
Dragon FruitFrugling
Bamboo ShootPandaroo
BerryZaplet
CarrotDroppit
Phantom FruitMaskfry
Clocko FruitHootlet
Find support by UID. Open Support, use the search button, and enter a trainer’s UID to find the required Tatari and request support. Check its availability and bonus before inviting. Save reliable support UIDs for future rounds.

Growth stages and upgrade bonuses

Growth stateWeight requiredUpgrade bonus weight
Stage 1 · Starting crop0+0
Stage 2 · Blue1,000+40
Stage 3 · Purple2,000+40
Stage 4 · Gold4,600+40
Stage 5 · Red12,000+80

Each threshold applies to one crop. Claiming an eligible upgrade adds the listed flat bonus weight toward progression; it is not a percentage boost to fertilizer or watering.

Watering: how much weight?

+5 weight per active crop. With six active crops, one watering adds 6 × 5 = 30 total weight.

Watering adds a flat amount to each crop with positive weight. An empty plot does not count. The inspected watering calculation does not apply your support percentage or fertilizer crit multiplier. If only four crops are active, the total is 4 × 5 = 20.

Arrange support before fertilizing

  1. Find an eligible support Tatari for a crop you plan to grow.
  2. Wait until support has actually taken effect before spending fertilizer.
  3. Water teammates and check support each round. Earlier weight gains do not receive a new support bonus retroactively.
  4. Compare your next milestone with the fertilizer you are prepared to spend.

1x84%

Estimate a support bonus

Use the support Tatari’s client-summary star, evolution, and food values. This checks the recovered support formula, not a full harvest prediction.

Support matters most

  • Natural growth adds a base 3 kg to each growing crop every hour, including while you are offline. Support increases this hourly gain on its assigned crop: base growth × (1 + support bonus ÷ 100). The bonus starts when support takes effect; earlier growth is not boosted retroactively. Arrange stronger support early to benefit from more hourly growth.
  • Weight persists between rounds; an invitation’s timing and reservation expiry still matter.
  • Compare available support and the milestone gap. I prefer spending fertilizer on one crop with the highest support bonus.
